notes: At the user’s request all animation changes, integration and review artifacts are on animation/opening-integration. The approved level3-dev game and stable preview aliases are not advanced or merged.

The urgent email keeps a pointing arrow and gentle emphasis until clicked. All three unseen students have pointing arrows; observed students have checks. Connected portrait indicators show the all-three completion requirement without added written instructions. Look around is larger and remains between observations.

Normal authored inspection durations are 450ms approach, 1500ms response and 450ms return. Real elapsed browser measurements including click actionability are retained in the suites. Other camera waits are shortened; email reading and decisions remain manual.

After all three distinct students, Return to Office reveals a short LEVEL 01 / One metric entry. Choose a metric calls the real completion callback once with the trimmed player name. FullGame then keeps Gameplay mounted across all three levels.

Opening styles and colour variables are scoped; the real Level 1 coral button and teacher portrait/name are verified after handoff. Shared mute preference, closed-page restore, touch, reduced-motion static cues and required three-student gating were exercised.

All five partner runtime PNGs retain their original bytes. Source under src/levels, src/shared and Gameplay.tsx is unchanged from the approved game baseline. Standalone entries begin directly at their own levels and retain the approved rules.

The actual complete bundle includes the integrated opening/full game and all three standalone levels. Four production builds and six current archives are from one source fingerprint. The original unmodified opening preview archive is preserved separately.

The opening checks ran once against the live source and once against exact full-game ZIP bytes using normal real-time playback. The release suite completes opening → Levels 1 → 2 → 3, checks standalone entries, archive hashes and fresh reload at the opening. All24checks passed with no runtime errors.

Managed Chromium offline checks use exact HTML through an in-memory HTTPS route; direct local file navigation in a particular user browser is not claimed. Later classroom/final animations are still placeholders and Design Lab navigation remains absent.
